verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage runs AML screening, payment screening and transaction monitoring, so accepting verified agent identity as a risk signal is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions agentic-payment protocols, signed agent tokens or delegated spending scopes as inputs. The 'agents' in the evidence are ComplyAdvantage's own internal AI workflow agents, and the configurable risk-score equation is only an adjacent control.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pass verified agent identity — agentic-payment protocols, signed agent tokens, delegated spending scopes — into the risk decision as a first-class signal
